headline: Measles -- Arizona
source: CDC, Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report
blurb: Maricopa County reported 54 measles cases from March 14 to July 11, 1985, in an outbreak that spread from a large school-based outbreak in neighboring Pima County.

headline: Maricopa County Health Department v. Harmon
source: Arizona Court of Appeals (via Harvard Law School Caselaw Access Project)
blurb: The Arizona Court of Appeals let stand a court order that kept a group of children out of Franklin Elementary School until March 18, 1986, unless they showed proof of measles vaccination.

headline: Epidemiologic Notes and Reports Erythromycin-Resistant Bordetella pertussis -- Yuma County, Arizona, May-October 1994
source: CDC, Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report
blurb: On June 27, 1994, Arizona health officials received a report of a 2-month-old in Yuma County who had whooping cough caused by a strain that resisted the antibiotic erythromycin.

headline: School-Associated Pertussis Outbreak --- Yavapai County, Arizona, September 2002--February 2003
source: CDC, Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report
blurb: A whooping cough outbreak that was first reported at a Yavapai County middle school on September 21, 2002, reached 485 reported cases in six communities.

headline: The “Arizona Strip” Whooping Cough Cluster
source: Arizona Department of Health Services, Director's Blog
blurb: Arizona's health director wrote that a whooping cough outbreak in the Colorado City area had lasted a year and a half and had more than 500 cases, mostly in children.

headline: New Vaccine Exemption Form Being Used this Year
source: Arizona Department of Health Services, Director's Blog
blurb: The Arizona Department of Health Services updated its school vaccine exemption form so that parents initial and date next to each vaccine they decline.

headline: Notes from the Field: Measles Outbreak at a United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement Facility ― Arizona, May–June 2016
source: CDC, Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report
blurb: After a detainee at an immigration detention center in Arizona was confirmed to have measles on May 25, 2016, investigators found 31 cases in all, in 22 detainees and nine staff members.

headline: Hepatitis A Outbreak Dashboard and Resources are Live
source: Arizona Department of Health Services, Director's Blog
blurb: The Arizona Department of Health Services launched an online dashboard to track a hepatitis A outbreak that had more than 300 cases since November 2018.
